skill.name: nature-ref-verifier
skill.description: Verifies scholarly references across independent sources and compares authors, titles, dates, volumes, issues, pages, and DOI records.
skill.summary: Find citation metadata errors and produce evidence-based correction reports.
skill.author: yuan1z0825

security_audit.summary: The high-entropy and shell-backtick alerts are false positives caused by readable Markdown, code fences, and Chinese text. The skill makes legitimate Crossref requests and recommends Zotero writes, including risky direct database editing.

remediation.issue: Direct Zotero database editing can corrupt the library or cause data loss.
remediation.suggestion: Remove this path, or require explicit confirmation, a verified backup, and Zotero shutdown before any database change.

remediation.issue: Zotero API and connector operations can modify the user's library.
remediation.suggestion: Show the proposed changes and require explicit approval before every write or batch update.

remediation.issue: Crossref requests disclose submitted DOI values to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the network request, encode DOI path values, use timeouts, and obtain confirmation when references are sensitive.

content.value_statement: Incorrect citation metadata can undermine manuscripts and delay publication. This skill compares references with authoritative sources and produces evidence-based corrections.
actual_capabilities: Parses numbered reference lists, single citations, and BibTeX entries.
Checks DOI resolution through Crossref before broader searches.
Compares authors, titles, dates, volume, issue, pages, DOI, and journal fields.
Classifies differences as critical, warning, informational, or unverifiable.
Produces Markdown reports, BibTeX corrections, and Zotero update instructions.
Uses alternative scholarly sources when Crossref lacks a record.
limitations: Verification depends on available network access and configured scholarly databases.
Crossref may not cover older IEEE papers or Chinese journal DOIs.
Paywalled and inaccessible records may remain unverifiable.
Zotero changes require user review and appropriate credentials.

use_cases.title: Check a manuscript before submission
use_cases.description: Audit every bibliography entry and identify corrections supported by authoritative records.

use_cases.title: Resolve reviewer citation concerns
use_cases.description: Verify disputed references and prepare concise evidence for a revision response.

use_cases.title: Clean a reference library
use_cases.description: Compare BibTeX or Zotero metadata and prepare reviewed correction instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Verify one citation
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this citation against authoritative sources. Compare every available field and explain any difference: [citation]
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs to check one reference.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a reference list
prompt_templates.prompt: Check these references individually. Group results as verified, check suggested, needs fix, or unverifiable. Cite the evidence for each correction: [references]
prompt_templates.scenario: A manuscript author needs a complete bibliography review.

prompt_templates.title: Review BibTeX metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this BibTeX content. Compare authors, title, year, volume, issue, pages, journal, and DOI. Prepare corrections without applying them: [BibTeX]
prompt_templates.scenario: A research team wants reviewed BibTeX corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate conflicting records
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate these conflicting records across Crossref, publisher pages, and suitable alternatives. Explain source authority, publication-state changes, uncertainty, and recommended fields: [records]
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs evidence-based conflict resolution.

output_examples.input: Verify a citation whose DOI resolves to a different paper.
output_examples.output: Needs fix: The DOI points to another title and author list. Replace it only after confirming the publisher record.

output_examples.input: Check a reference with a 2024 online date and a 2025 volume year.
output_examples.output: Check suggested: The dates describe different publication stages. Use the formal volume year and retain the online date when required.

output_examples.input: Audit a citation that no configured source can locate.
output_examples.output: Unverifiable: No authoritative record was available. Keep the original entry and add it to the manual review list.

best_practices: Provide complete citations and identify the citation style or required output format.
Allow checks against DOI registries, publisher pages, and relevant regional databases.
Review all proposed BibTeX or Zotero changes before applying them.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a single search result as conclusive evidence.
Do not infer publication dates only from the DOI text.
Do not write directly to Zotero databases without approval and a backup.

faq.question: Which input formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill accepts reference lists, single citations, BibTeX content, Zotero item keys, and manuscript bibliography pages.

faq.question: Which sources can it check?
faq.answer: It can use Crossref, IEEE Xplore, publisher pages, web search, CNKI, Wanfang, and configured Zotero access.

faq.question: Can it verify references without a DOI?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search by title and author, but confidence depends on source coverage.

faq.question: Does it modify Zotero automatically?
faq.answer: It can prepare update instructions. Any library write should require user review, approval, and suitable credentials.

faq.question: How are uncertain references reported?
faq.answer: Records without reliable evidence are marked unverifiable and placed on a manual review list.

faq.question: Can it resolve online and volume-year conflicts?
faq.answer: It explains publication-stage differences and recommends fields based on authoritative journal records.
